node: Franchise procurement, sourcing, and supply-chain orchestration
summary: This pass expands the public-market universe around the infrastructure layer that lets restaurant and coffee franchisors standardize sourcing, assure supply, manage limited-time offers, control cost of goods, and support national unit growth. The cleanest public reference exposure is broadline foodservice distribution, especially Sysco, US Foods, and Performance Food Group. The underfollowed lane is narrower: specialty distributors and smaller franchise systems with explicit dependence on outsourced distribution partnerships may provide earlier evidence of supply-chain orchestration becoming a gating factor, but several require later verification of actual franchise customer contracts, exclusivity, customer concentration, and margin capture.
